candidates.description: This vector represents personal pronouns and possessive determiners across different languages and grammatical forms.
This vector represents concepts and terminology associated with romantic gifts, holidays, sensory descriptions, and rich indulgences.
This vector activates strongly on common coordinating and subordinating conjunctions and prepositions used to link clauses and phrases.
This vector activates in response to Roman numerals and their textual representations.
This feature activates on quotation marks and text immediately following them.
This vector represents universal quantifiers and words denoting totality or completeness across multiple languages.
Demonstrative pronouns and determiners indicating proximity or reference, predominantly in Romance languages and English.
This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords starting with the letters "Es" or "es" in Spanish and English contexts.
This vector represents the letter 'v' and words or subwords containing it.
This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "el" and its variants across multiple languages.
